bottleneck: Decode throughput on the frozen workload is GPU-kernel-bound, not host-bound. Measured on the controller's real BF16 C128 decode trace (packet 20261110-decode-trace, run a3b0f3ec, node a1, source commit 15fd7f4): device busy 98.9164% of the 571.927ms marked window; host time not hidden under device activity only 5919.8us = 1.0351% of wall; hard sync-with-device-idle bubbles 0.4872%. Decode step anatomy (kernel sum 567.3ms ~= union 565.5ms, single stream => wall shares): attention 47.04% (16.68ms/step = 28 x ~595us flashinfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheKernel tensor-core decode; zero BatchDecode kernels), GEMM 47.83%, other 5.14%. The two ~47% walls are KV bytes and weight bytes; only precision-class changes attack walls of that size on this node.
